project.name: Vidocq :: Core Extensions :: Mansart Data :: Codegen Bundle
project.description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-mansart-data-extension. Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the application depends on the Mansart Data extension.
Pulls in: - mansart-data-processor : generates _Entity metamodel + *RepositoryImpl stubs + META-INF/mansart-repositories.list. - mansart-data-cdi : hosts the BuildCompatibleExtension and the @Produces RepositoryRuntime. The APT classloader (isolated by Maven) must see the BCE; without it, the DeploymentValidator rejects every @Inject of a repository or of RepositoryRuntime.
